summary: Frontend-only test of Eventos page galleries (Escenarios / Premiación) using the new GalleryCarousel component. Verified carousel visual style, prev/next arrows, auto-rotation, empty state, and regression of surrounding sections. All 6 test cases PASS. One important note: in current DB, Escenarios has 0 photos configured (scenarios_photos: []) so it correctly renders the 'Aún no hay fotos configuradas.' empty state — this is expected behavior, NOT a bug, but main agent should be aware that Escenarios needs photos configured via Admin to be visually verified. Premiación has 6 photos configured and works perfectly.
action_items: OPTIONAL: Configure at least 3-5 photos in home_settings.eventos.scenarios_photos via Admin so the Escenarios carousel can be visually verified end-to-end (currently shows empty state which is correct fallback but hides the carousel UI). No code fix needed.
critical_code_review_comments: GalleryCarousel.jsx is clean, well documented, reusable. Uses framer-motion transition of 0.7s — rapid consecutive clicks (<700ms apart) can appear to 'not update' the center img until transition settles; this is cosmetic only, state is correctly updated. Consider disabling next/prev during transition if UX concerns arise.
Auto-rotate only triggers when list.length > 3 (correct per spec). Cleanup of setInterval is proper.
visible = [0,1,2].map((i) => list[(idx + i) % list.length]) works but only shows 3 items even if user has exactly 3 photos — arrows still enabled and will rotate through the same 3; acceptable.

During AnimatePresence transition, DOM temporarily contains 2-3 elements in the middle slot (old exiting + new entering). Queries selecting the first img can return the outgoing image if measured mid-transition; not a real bug.
test_credentials: Not required (public content). Admin (if needed to seed scenarios photos): admin@futuresoccercup.com / FSCAdmin2025!
seed_data_creation: None created. scenarios_photos is empty in current DB — main agent may want to add seed images.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GalleryCarousel component verified working on /eventos for both Escenarios (empty state path) and Premiación (6 photos, active carousel). When testing carousel image changes, wait >=1000ms after click before reading center img src to let framer-motion 0.7s transition settle, and select ALL matching elements not just first (multiple exist during transition).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial false-positive on 'prev click doesn't change image' was due to (a) measuring first mid-transition while both exit+enter nodes coexist, and (b) auto-rotate racing with click at 5s interval. Retest with 1.5s wait after click confirmed clicks work correctly.

visual_verification.scenarios_section: Renders empty-state placeholder 'Aún no hay fotos configuradas.' — correct (DB has 0 photos)
visual_verification.premiacion_section: Renders 3-up carousel: center image 596px wide with shadow-2xl+ring-4, side images 286px wide with opacity-70; circular ChevronLeft/Right arrows on both sides; prev/next clicks rotate images; auto-rotate every 5s working (6 images total). Screenshot matches Inicio FINALES gallery style.
visual_verification.regression: eventos-hero, eventos-countries, eventos-tabs, adventure-section, clubs-section all present and rendering.
